storyPoints.title: Běžný provoz
storyPoints.description: Všichni dodavatelé dodávají převážně včas, zásoby na prodejnách jsou stabilní a poptávka zákazníků je rovnoměrná.

storyPoints.title: Problémový dodavatel začíná dodávat pozdě
storyPoints.description: Od března výrazně roste pravděpodobnost pozdní dodávky u problémového dodavatele. Pozdní dodávky mají zpoždění 7–21 dní. Poptávka ani ostatní dodavatelé se nemění.

storyPoints.title: Výpadky zásob, ztracené prodeje a stížnosti
storyPoints.description: Zboží problémového dodavatele chybí na prodejnách, přibývá neuskutečněných nákupů a stížností a tržby z jeho zboží klesají. Poptávka zůstává stejná.

expectations.description: Podíl pozdních objednávek u problémového dodavatele vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT CAST(order_date AS DATE) d, CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS late FROM purchase_order WHERE supplier_profile = 'problémový') SELECT CASE WHEN d < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN d >= DATE '2025-03-15' THEN 'after' END AS period, AVG(late) AS value FROM o WHERE d < DATE '2025-03-01' OR d >= DATE '2025-03-15' GROUP BY 1

expectations.description: Počet ztracených prodejů za den u zboží problémového dodavatele vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) d FROM sale), per AS (SELECT d, CASE WHEN d < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN d >= DATE '2025-03-15' THEN 'after' END AS period FROM days), x AS (SELECT CAST(l.date AS DATE) d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lost_sale l JOIN product p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN supplier su ON su.id = p.supplier_id WHERE su.profile = 'problémový' GROUP BY 1) SELECT per.period AS period, SUM(COALESCE(x.n, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM per LEFT JOIN x ON x.d = per.d WHERE per.period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY per.period

expectations.description: Počet stížností za den na zboží problémového dodavatele vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) d FROM sale), per AS (SELECT d, CASE WHEN d < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN d >= DATE '2025-03-15' THEN 'after' END AS period FROM days), x AS (SELECT CAST(c.date AS DATE) d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM complaint c JOIN supplier su ON su.id = c.supplier_id WHERE su.profile = 'problémový' GROUP BY 1) SELECT per.period AS period, SUM(COALESCE(x.n, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM per LEFT JOIN x ON x.d = per.d WHERE per.period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY per.period

expectations.description: Denní tržby ze zboží problémového dodavatele klesnou.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) d FROM sale), per AS (SELECT d, CASE WHEN d < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN d >= DATE '2025-03-15' THEN 'after' END AS period FROM days), x AS (SELECT CAST(s.date AS DATE) d, SUM(s.quantity * s.unit_price) AS rev FROM sale s JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id JOIN supplier su ON su.id = p.supplier_id WHERE su.profile = 'problémový' GROUP BY 1) SELECT per.period AS period, SUM(COALESCE(x.rev, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM per LEFT JOIN x ON x.d = per.d WHERE per.period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY per.period

expectations.description: Kontrola: denní tržby ze zboží spolehlivých dodavatelů zůstanou stabilní.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) d FROM sale), per AS (SELECT d, CASE WHEN d < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN d >= DATE '2025-03-15' THEN 'after' END AS period FROM days), x AS (SELECT CAST(s.date AS DATE) d, SUM(s.quantity * s.unit_price) AS rev FROM sale s JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id JOIN supplier su ON su.id = p.supplier_id WHERE su.profile = 'spolehlivý' GROUP BY 1) SELECT per.period AS period, SUM(COALESCE(x.rev, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM per LEFT JOIN x ON x.d = per.d WHERE per.period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY per.period

expectations.description: Kontrola: celková poptávka (prodeje + ztracené prodeje) za den zůstane stabilní.
expectations.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT CAST(date AS DATE) d FROM sale UNION ALL SELECT CAST(date AS DATE) d FROM lost_sale), days AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) d FROM sale), per AS (SELECT d, CASE WHEN d < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN d >= DATE '2025-03-15' THEN 'after' END AS period FROM days), x AS (SELECT d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ev GROUP BY d) SELECT per.period AS period, SUM(COALESCE(x.n, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM per LEFT JOIN x ON x.d = per.d WHERE per.period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY per.period
